entries.title: Psalms 48:1
segments: ¶<<A Song; a Psalm. Of the sons of Korah.>> Great is Jehovah, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in the hill of his holiness.

entries.title: Psalms 48:2
segments: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is mount Zion, [on] the sides of the north, the city of the great King.

entries.title: Psalms 48:3
segments: God is known in her palaces as a high fortress.

entries.title: Psalms 48:4
segments: For behold, the kings assembled themselves, they passed by together;

entries.title: Psalms 48:5
segments: They saw, --so they marvelled; they were troubled, they fled in consternation:

entries.title: Psalms 48:6
segments: Trembling took hold upon them there; anguish, as of a woman in travail.

entries.title: Psalms 48:7
segments: With an east wind thou hast broken the ships of Tarshish.

entries.title: Psalms 48:8
segments: ¶As we have heard, so have we seen, in the city of Jehovah of hosts, in the city of our God: God doth establish it for ever. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 48:9
segments: We have thought, O God, of thy loving-kindness, in the midst of thy temple.

entries.title: Psalms 48:10
segments: According to thy name, O God, so is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: thy right hand is full of righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 48:11
segments: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of thy judgments.

entries.title: Psalms 48:12
segments: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: count the towers thereof;

entries.title: Psalms 48:13
segments: Mark ye well her bulwarks, consider her palaces: that ye may tell it to the generation following.

entries.title: Psalms 48:14
segments: For this God is our God for ever and ever; he will be our guide until death.
